paite: Khopi helhat leh buah, nuaisiah ching tung agik hi!
heading: Jerusalem Khelhna Leh Tatna
english: Woe to her who is rebellious and polluted, the oppressing city!

paite: Kuamah thu angaikhe kei a, bawlhoihna leng asang thei kei. amuanna leng TOUPA ah a-om kei a; a Pathian anaih sam kei hi.
english: She didn’t obey the voice. She didn’t receive correction. She didn’t trust in Yahweh. She didn’t draw near to her God.

paite: Asung a aheutu liante uh humpinelkai humham ahi ua, avaihawmte uh lah nitaklam ngehon, azingchiang a nek ding nuse ut lou bang ahi uh.
english: Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.

paite: Azawlneite uh lah mizuauthei leh lepchiah ahi ua; asiampute un mun siangthou ahihbuah ua, dan tung ah ahiamgam uhi.
english: Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people. Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the law.

paite: Asung ua TOUPA bel adiktat a; thil thulim lou ahih kei ding; zingsang teng in avaihawm khovak ah alak a, avuaksuak ngei kei a; himahleh midiktatloute'n zaw zumna athei kei uhi.
english: Yahweh, within her, is righteous. He will do no wrong. Every morning he brings his justice to light. He doesn’t fail, but the unjust know no shame.

paite: Namte ka satkheta a, a-insangte uh akisegawp hi; akongzingte uh ka susia a, kuamah apai kei uhi; akhopite uh hihsiat in a-om a, huchi a mi kuamah om lou in, ateng leng a-om kei uhi.
english: I have cut off nations. Their battlements are desolate. I have made their streets waste, so that no one passes by. Their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, so that there is no inhabitant.

paite: Chihtaktak in kei na hon kihta ding ua, bawlhoihna na kipahpih ding, ka chi a; huchi in atenna satkhiak in a-om kei dia, amah tungtang a sehsa tengteng bang in; himahleh beltak in athou ua, ahih tengteng uh asesak uhi.
english: I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction,” so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her. But they rose early and corrupted all their doings.

paite: "Huaiziak in mat ding zuan a ka thoh ni atun masiah hon na ngak un," TOUPA'N achi. Namte kaihkhawm ka tup ahi ngal a, lalgamte ka suktuah a atung ua ka hehna ka sunbuak theihna ding in, ka thangpaihna lauhuai tengteng; ka mullitna mei a leitung pumpi nekgaih a om ding lah ahi ngal a.
english: “Therefore wait for me”, says Yahweh, “until the day that I rise up to the prey, for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms to pour on them my indignation, even all my fierce anger, for all the earth will be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.

paite: Huai hun chiang a mite'n TOUPA min aloh ua, thukhat sat a amah nna aseptheihna ding un, akiang uah muk siangthou ka pe ding hi.
english: For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on Yahweh’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.

paite: Ethiopia luite khen lam a kipan gimlim hal mite, dalhsa ka mite tanu mahmah in ka thillat ahon tawi ding hi.
english: From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my dispersed people, will bring my offering.

paite: Huai ni chiang in ka tung a na tatlekna, na thilhihte tengteng ziak in na zahlak kei ding; huai hun chiang a na lak a na mikisathei leh ki-uangsakte lakhe ding ka hih ziak in, huchi in ka tang siangthou ah na ki-uangsak nawnta kei ding uhi.
english: In that day you will not be disappointed for all your doings in which you have transgressed against me; for then I will take away out from among you your proudly exulting ones, and you will no more be arrogant in my holy mountain.

paite: Himahleh na lak ah mi gimthuak leh genthei ka nuse ding a, TOUPA ah amuang ding uhi.
english: But I will leave among you an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in Yahweh’s name.

paite: Israel khosuaksunte'n gilou ahih kei ding ua, zuau agen sam kei ding uh; akam uah leng lei khemhat akimu kei ding hi; ne a, lum a, amaute kuamah in ahihlau louh ding ziak un.
english: The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth, for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.”

paite: La sa in, Aw Zion tanu; kikou in, aw Israel! Jerusalem tanu aw, na lungtang tengteng toh kipak inla, nuamsa in!
heading: Kipahna La
english: Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.

paite: TOUPA'N na vaihawmnate alamangta a, na melma adelhkhia a, na lak ah Israel kumpipa, TOUPA a-om hi; gilou na lau nawn kei ding hi.
english: Yahweh has taken away your judgments. He has thrown out your enemy. The King of Israel, Yahweh, is among you. You will not be afraid of evil any more.

paite: Huai ni chiang in, Jerusalem kiang ah, "Lau ke'n," chih ahi ding; Aw Zion, na khutte ze-olsak ke'n.
english: In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands be weak.”

paite: Na lak ah TOUPA na Pathian a-om hi, hondam ding mihat; na itna ah akhawl ding, la sa in na tung ah anuam ding hi.
english: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.

paite: Khawmpi kulmut ziak a dahnate, noute a dia puakgik leh gensiatna hiite ka lamang ding hi.
english: I will remove those who grieve about the appointed feasts from you. They are a burden and a reproach to you.

paite: Ngai in, huai hun chiang in, nang hihgimte tengteng ka bawl ding a, panpih kiphamohnu ka hondam ding a, hawlmang a omnu ka lakhawm ding; huchi in leitung pumpi a azahlakna uh ana omkhitnate ah, phatna leh minthanna amaute ka pe ding hi.
english: Behold, at that time I will deal with all those who afflict you; and I will save those who are lame and gather those who were driven away. I will give them praise and honor, whose shame has been in all the earth.

paite: Huai hun chiang in ka hon la nawn ding a, huai hun chiang in nou ka hon kaikhawm ding hi; na mitmuh ua na saltanna ua kipan ka hon pi nawn hun chiang in, lei a mi tengteng lak ah min leh phatna in nou ka hon bawl ding, TOUPA'N achita hi.
english: At that time I will bring you in, and at that time I will gather you; for I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says Yahweh.
